text: Gary Marcus Oct 14, 2026 15 8 3 Share Greetings from New Delhi. In an emailed newsletter, Laura Bratton at The Information has reported on a new study (direct link not available): Anybody remember back in early 2023, when people imagined that ChatGPT was going to 10x every employee’s productivity and radically boost the GDP’s of entire countries? So far, there’s zero evidence of anything like that happening at scale. The juxtaposition between the minimal documentable ROI and the trillions of dollars invested in this technology remains perverse and often baffling . P.S.
